title: Coral and the Glasshouse
author: Zephyrine Underhill
blurb: Lior Oyelaran, a bridge inspector measuring the marriage in expansion joints, keeps a careful inventory of everything unsaid. Then a box of undelivered letters surfaces behind a wardrobe — and they are pulled straight into the middle of it. To get through this, they must say goodbye properly, at last, out loud before the house sale closes.
style: warm, character-driven storytelling with gentle humor
